title: A Famous Inventor
text:
Alexander Graham Bell was a Scottish inventor. He lived in Canada and in the United States. He is famous for the telephone. Many people use his invention every day.

Bell worked on his ideas for many years. He made many tests before the telephone worked well. His friends helped him with his experiments. Today we still talk on phones that come from his invention.

questions.text: Where did Alexander Graham Bell live?
options: In Canada and the United States

questions.text: What did Bell make many tests for?
What can the reader infer about Bell?
options: He was patient and worked hard on his ideas
He did not like his friends
He stopped working after one test

questions.text: Why is Bell's invention still important today?
options: Because people still use phones based on it
Because he wrote many school books
Because he was a famous singer
Because he lived on a ship

vocabulary.definition: a person who creates a new machine or product
actions done to check how something works
careful trials to discover something new

paragraph_translations: Alexander Graham Bell foi um inventor escocês. Ele morou no Canadá e nos Estados Unidos. Ele é famoso pelo telefone. Muitas pessoas usam a sua invenção todos os dias.

Bell trabalhou nas suas ideias por muitos anos. Ele fez muitos testes antes de o telefone funcionar bem. Os seus amigos ajudaram nos seus experimentos. Hoje ainda falamos em telefones que vêm da sua invenção.
